full_prompt_en: A square geometric mixed-media graphic shows an intricate arrangement of colored blocks, circles, arches, and drafting lines centered on aged cream paper. The pale ground extends widely to all four sides, leaving the construction as a compact vertical mass in the middle. At the upper left of the mass, a deep teal circle partly overlaps a pale rectangular bar and a thin incomplete arc. Near the upper center, a tall rust-red vertical slab rises beside smaller ochre and gray rectangles. On the right, narrow teal columns, white openings, and black bars interlock like an abstract building section. Across the middle, long horizontal red and dark gray lines project beyond the main cluster, as if measurement guides have not been erased. Lower down, rounded teal corners and larger ochre blocks balance stacked black and gray windows. A thick dark bar holds the base just above the lower margin. Many hairline gray construction marks continue past the colored forms and end in the open paper, giving the image a precise but unfinished drafting quality. Small black and red squares are separated from the main mass near the upper right. The colored planes have fine grain, slight fading, and tiny irregularities rather than perfectly smooth vector fill. Light is flat and even, as on a printed page, with depth implied through overlap, value contrast, and selective inset shadows rather than a depicted sun. No legible labels appear. The overall composition is disciplined but lively, its vertical core stabilized by projecting horizontals and its limited teal-rust-ochre palette set against broad cream negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形几何混合媒介图形在陈旧奶油色纸上居中排列复杂色块、圆形、拱弧和制图线。浅色底向四边宽阔延伸，让构造成为中央紧凑的竖向体块。体块左上，一枚深青色圆形与浅色矩形横条和一道未闭合细弧部分重叠。上方中央附近，一块高锈红竖板立在较小赭色与灰色矩形旁。右侧，狭长青绿立柱、白色开口和黑横条像抽象建筑剖面般咬合。中部，长红线和深灰水平线伸出主要色块，仿佛未擦掉的测量辅助线。更下方，圆角青绿色块和较大赭色块平衡叠置的黑灰窗状开口。一条厚深色横线在下边距上方压住基底。许多发丝般灰色构造线穿出彩色形体，在空白纸面上结束，赋予图像精确却未完工的制图质感。右上附近还有与主体分离的黑红小方块。色面带细颗粒、轻微褪色和极小不规则变化，而非完全平滑的矢量填充。光如印刷纸页般平坦均匀，深度由重叠、明度对比和选择性的嵌入阴影暗示，而非描绘太阳。没有可读标签。整体构图严谨却生动，竖向核心由伸出的水平线稳住，受限青绿、锈红和赭色配色置于宽阔奶油色留白中。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media graphic builds a compact central hierarchy from interlocking rectangles, circles, arcs, and projected hairline guides. Deep teal, muted rust, ochre, charcoal, and off-white are used as limited matte blocks on a visibly aged cream ground. Fine construction lines extend into wide negative space, balancing precise alignment with an intentionally unfinished feel. Small layered shadows and overlaps imply depth while overall illumination remains flat and page-like. Color planes are subtly speckled and uneven, preserving a printed or painted surface. Vertical masses are countered by long horizontal accents and isolated tiny marks. The overall effect is rational, rhythmic, and tactile, with geometric organization as the main expressive mechanism.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅混合媒介图形由互相咬合的矩形、圆形、弧线和伸出的发丝细辅助线建立紧凑中央层级。深青绿、暗锈红、赭色、炭色和灰白色作为受限哑光色块落在明显陈旧的奶油色底上。细构造线伸入宽阔负空间，在精确对齐与刻意未完成感之间取得平衡。小型层叠阴影和重叠暗示深度，整体照明仍如纸页般平坦。色面带轻微斑点和不均，保留印刷或绘画表面。竖向体块由长水平重音和孤立细小标记制衡。整体效果理性、有节奏且可触，几何组织是主要表现机制。
theme_en: An abstract arrangement of geometric blocks and drafting lines on cream paper
theme_zh: 奶油色纸张上几何块与制图线组成的抽象结构
name: Le Corbusier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
